login.title: Welcome to Shahamham
login.description: Log in to your account and continue your charity course from where you left off.
login.loginSuccess: You have been logged in successfully.
login.loginFailed: We couldn't log you in. Check your details and try again.
login.invitation: Join Shahamham by invitation — from your organization or from the Shahamham team.

contextSelection.title: How will you use the network today?
contextSelection.subtitle: Choose your context so we can arrange the right pages for you — you can switch at any time.
contextSelection.orgDesc: I work on behalf of my organization: I offer its services and resources on Namliya and participate in Hakima.
contextSelection.pubDesc: I work in my personal capacity: I sponsor organizations' services and make bookings through Khallis.
contextSelection.noteTitle: Your context filters content; it does not define your permissions.
contextSelection.noteDescription: What you see changes with your context, but your network rights stay the same.
contextSelection.switchHint: You can switch contexts at any time from the top bar.
contextSelection.switchFailed: We couldn't change your context. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Reset password?
resetPassword.description: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.loadingDescription: One moment while we prepare the password reset form.
resetPassword.unavailableDescription: The link may have expired or already been used. Request a new link to continue.
resetPassword.retryDescription: There was a connection problem. Try again without closing this page.
resetPassword.rateLimitedDescription: There have been too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
resetPassword.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
resetPassword.passwordMax: Password must be at most 128 characters.
resetPassword.resetFailed: We couldn't reset your password. Request a new link and try again.

forgetPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgetPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgetPassword.requestFailed: We couldn't send the reset link. Please try again.
forgetPassword.sentDescription: Check your email — the reset link is valid for 30 minutes.
forgetPassword.metaDescription: Request a password reset link for your Shahamham account.

inviteSignup.metaDescription: Create a Shahamham member or organization account from a secure invitation.
inviteSignup.loadingDescription: One moment while we prepare the invitation details.
inviteSignup.unavailableDescription: The link may have expired or already been used. Ask the sender for a new invitation.
inviteSignup.retryDescription: There was a connection problem. Try again without closing this page.
inviteSignup.rateLimitedDescription: There have been too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
inviteSignup.login: Already have an account? Log in
inviteSignup.memberInvite: {organization} invites you to join its team on Shahamham.
inviteSignup.memberDescription: One step and you're in — then we'll prepare your organization profile.
inviteSignup.organizationInvite: The Shahamham team invites your organization to join the network — complete the organization and administrator details.
inviteSignup.organizationDescription: These details prepare the organization profile for review before activation.
inviteSignup.accountDescription: You will be the organization's first administrator and can manage the team after approval.
inviteSignup.emailNote: The email is linked to the invitation and cannot be changed.
inviteSignup.areasPlaceholder: Type an area and press Enter
inviteSignup.termsAfterOrganization: and agree to them on behalf of the organization.
inviteSignup.memberTerms: I have read and agree to the <conditions>terms and conditions</conditions> and the <charter>network charter</charter>.
inviteSignup.nameMax: This text exceeds the allowed length.
inviteSignup.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
inviteSignup.consentRequired: You must accept the charter and terms to continue.
inviteSignup.legalNameMax: Organization name must not exceed 255 characters.
inviteSignup.existingAccount: This email belongs to an existing account, while this invitation requires a new account. Log in or ask the organization administrator to invite another email.
inviteSignup.submitFailed: We couldn't complete registration. Your details are still here; review them and try again.
inviteSignup.organizationSuccessDescription: The email is verified and the organization account was created. The Shahamham team must approve the organization and administrator before sign-in.
